deploybot: Tag v2.3.0-rc4 created and pushed to origin for release candidate testing. Target path: staging -> canary -> prod. Commit: 7f3b2c9. Changelog (high level):
- runtime: reduce batching tail latency for short sequences
- api: fix streaming chunk order bug
- infra: autoscaler tune to prevent cold starts during spikes
- docs: update upgrade notes for quantized models

Git: `git tag -a v2.3.0-rc4 7f3b2c9 -m "rc4" && git push origin v2.3.0-rc4`
Link: https://git.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.0-rc4 (changelog + artifacts) :rocket:

margaret: ack. can we pin embedding-service to v2.2.1 on prod during the canary? want to avoid regressions for embeddings-heavy routes.

ishaan: +1 on pin. also prefer a 10m smoke window in staging, then 1h 5% canary in prod. if perf looks good we ramp. who owns rollback if perf drops?

release-eng: I can own rollback. rollback plan quick notes:
1) cut traffic back to v2.2.1 (prod) via rollout policy
2) if pod image needs revert: `kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model=redwood/model:v2.2.1 -n prod`
3) open ticket and mark release as red. Have previous tag ready: v2.2.1 (commit a9d8e7f)

ci-bot: build artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-releases/v2.3.0-rc4/artifacts.tar.gz. smoke-tests: PASS. perf-check: +1.1% p99 latency on staging (short seq). Full perf suite queued (ETA ~18m).

ava: leaving a note: please set prod canary to 5% traffic for first hour, monitor token-cost and p99. I'll watch dashboards. ping me with :bell: when canary starts.

margaret: thanks — pin requested and noted. tagging release notes in the release ticket now.

deploybot: Canary rollout scheduled: start at 2026-04-02T15:10:00Z, initial traffic 5%. Notifying on #incidents if any alerts fire.
